details.jobDescription:
PuntoUP Recruitment Agency is looking for an Application Support Team Lead - Finance for a Swiss, privately owned international agri-business active in fertilisers and grains. The role leads support for the company's Finance IT applications, with direct ownership of Treasury and Tax systems, and is a first formal step into people leadership while staying close to hands-on support. If you know treasury processes and finance application support well, we'd like to hear from you.

Location: Constanta or Bucharest, Romania

Main Purpose of the Job: Coordinate day-to-day support of the Finance IT landscape - SAP for accounting, a treasury management system and a tax-determination solution, plus the interfaces connecting them - leading the internal support team and external vendors so that incidents, requests and recurring issues are resolved.

Job Profile:

  • Lead, coach and develop the Finance applications support team, including objective setting, one-to-ones and performance reviews.

  • Own the support backlog and prioritise incidents, requests, problems and escalations by business impact and agreed service levels.

  • Coordinate external support vendors and managed service providers, monitor progress and challenge delays or quality issues.

  • Act as the main coordination point for critical incidents, keeping stakeholders informed through to resolution.

  • Serve as key IT contact for treasury processes and the treasury management system, and for tax processes and tax determination.

  • Oversee support for SAP accounting and core finance processes, ensuring issues are routed and followed up.

  • Work with Treasury, Tax and Finance stakeholders to assess business impact and translate needs into support or change actions.

  • Investigate cross-system issues involving transactions, interfaces, controls, reporting and data consistency.

  • Maintain an end-to-end view of systems, interfaces (file- and API-based) and data flows across the finance landscape.

  • Lead root-cause analysis for recurring issues and keep documentation, process maps and knowledge articles up to date.

  • Coordinate changes, testing, regression, release readiness and post-release validation within ITSM governance.

  • Identify ways to simplify support, reduce manual effort and improve stability, data quality and user experience.

Candidate Profile:

  • Proven experience supporting finance applications in a complex, integrated business environment.

  • Strong practical knowledge of treasury operations and processes.

  • Ability to support tax applications and coordinate tax-determination issues.

  • Experience coordinating support activities, managing escalations and working with internal teams and external vendors.

  • Some experience in team coordination, mentoring or workstream leadership, and readiness to take on formal people management.

  • Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, functional testing, release support and documentation.

  • Working knowledge of Incident, Change and Service Request Management; ITIL Foundation is a plus.

  • Exposure to a treasury management system, SAP finance (incl. S/4HANA) or a tax-determination solution is an advantage.

  • Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware or file-based interfaces, and with international outsourced teams, is a plus.

  • Structured, analytical approach and clear communication with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Benefits:

  • Meal vouchers.

  • Holiday, Christmas and Easter bonuses, plus seasonal gifts for employees and their children.

  • International work environment within a global IT applications team.

All candidates who meet the above qualifications are warmly encouraged to submit their applications online. We will reach out exclusively to those who are best suited for the role within a maximum of two weeks.

For other job opportunities, visit our website at www.puntoup.com and upload your CV to our database to remain eligible for both current and future positions. All applications are handled with the utmost confidentiality.

By submitting your personal data via email to any address ending in “www.puntoup.com” or “www.puntoup.ro,” through social media platforms (such as Facebook, LinkedIn), or by applying via an online job portal, you provide explicit consent for PuntoUP and its affiliated companies to process your data. For more information, please refer to our data processing policy. Should you have any concerns regarding your personal data, kindly contact dataprivacy@puntoup.com.
